name: Deploy a Netlify Site
description: Trigger a new deploy for a Netlify site. Supports production deploys, deploy previews, branch targeting, and custom deploy titles.

production.description: Set true for a production deploy

code.source:
const resp = $.steps.createDeploy.response || {};
return {
  deployId: resp.id || '',
  siteId: resp.site_id || '',
  state: resp.state || '',
  url: resp.ssl_url || resp.url || '',
  deployUrl: resp.deploy_ssl_url || resp.deploy_url || '',
  adminUrl: resp.admin_url || '',
  branch: resp.branch || '',
  context: resp.context || '',
  title: resp.title || '',
  createdAt: resp.created_at || '',
  summary: resp.id ? `Deploy ${resp.id} created (state: ${resp.state || 'unknown'}) for ${resp.ssl_url || resp.url || 'site'}` : 'Failed to create deploy'
};
